name: PPSSPP
short_description: Self-hosted PSP emulator with web UI for remote gaming and game management.
description: PPSSPP is a self-hosted PSP emulator powered by LinuxServer.io, providing a full emulation experience in the browser. Play your PSP game library from any device with save state support, controller configuration, and graphics scaling.
usecases: Play PSP games remotely through a browser without needing a local emulator install.
Manage game ROMs, save states, and emulator configuration from any device.
Access your gaming library on-the-go with synchronized settings and progress.
notes: Data persistence is handled through a named Docker volume to preserve game saves and settings.
You will need to provide your own PSP firmware files and game ROMs.
